Researchers from Majority Action, an advocacy group focused on increasing sustainable economic investments, have concluded that the growth of data centers is also worsening climate change.
The AI data center boom is accelerating climate change by increasing our reliance on fossil fuels and deepening inequality by burdening communities with poor air quality and higher utility rates
